issues.legal_issue: A party that elects to pursue the same cause of action in another forum and abandons available challenges cannot relitigate those challenges later where doing so would constitute an abuse of process under the Henderson principle and constructive res judicata.
A transfer of property during pending proceedings may be subject to lis pendens despite the absence of a registered notice of pendency where the circumstances warrant applying the doctrine.

A confirmed SARFAESI auction sale should not be set aside for a procedural irregularity that could have been raised earlier unless a fundamental defect, fraud, collusion, inadequate pricing, underbidding, or substantial injury is established.

Issuance of a sale certificate pursuant to a final judgment confirming a SARFAESI sale confers absolute title and leaves no pending challenge to that sale for determination in the earlier securitization proceedings.
Deliberate conduct intended to frustrate or circumvent a court’s judgment may constitute contempt even without an express prohibitory order or specific direction addressing that conduct.
